summary: 16 four-panel sheets for 14 characters, all at 2560x1440. Every generation finished inside the run and none were rejected by the provider. Machine checks all pass. Visual self-check found defects on 10 sheets. These are listed per item and kept for user decision at H2, since the auto-retry budget is 0. Two Bible conflicts were filed as defects.
scope_note: All 14 entries are tier 'extra' in index.json. My SOUL normally covers S/A tier only, but this order explicitly assigns them for the H2 gate, so they were produced to the same standard. Ensemble entries got representative-member sheets, not crowd scenes.

shared_decisions.layout_anchor: code/character_sheet_template_p4-char-concept-cb3.jpg: a JPEG copy of agents/06-art/character-concept/templates/character_sheet_template.png, pixels unchanged. On this channel a true-PNG --ref triggers TLS resets. Used as the first --ref on every sheet.
shared_decisions.style_segment: bible/style.json style_fragment_ui verbatim in every prompt.
shared_decisions.negatives: bible/style.json negative_prompt_en verbatim in every --negative. Small per-sheet layout or identity additions are recorded in each prompts.json negative_note. negative_prompt_waking_addon_en is not applied because all 14 subjects are dream-world.
shared_decisions.default_costume: bible/costumes.json default outfit visual_en verbatim in every prompt. For ensembles it is quoted as the group rule, followed by what it means for the one member shown.

user_refs.used_as: look reference, read before prompting (tone, texture, light, palette). This is carried into the sheets through style_fragment_ui, which art-director derived from it.
user_refs.reason: The image contains other characters (Alice and the Caterpillar) that would leak into single-character sheets. Its digital matte-painting finish is also listed under style.json user_refs.not_adopted. refs/NOTES.md is absent, so there is no user annotation asking for injection. refs/characters/ is empty.

shared_decisions.probes: 3 pre-flight probes at 1280x720, each 1/4 price, stored in runs/p4-char-concept-cb3/probe/ (frog, jury guinea-pig, executioner). They verified layout and audit clearance and are not rerolls. After the frog probe, its body sentence was tightened, and pip-placement wording was added for Five and Seven after the Gardener Two result. All of this happened before those sheets' first and only full-size run.
shared_decisions.billing: 16 full-size 2560x1440 generations + 3 probes at 1280x720. 0 provider rejections, 0 resubmits, 0 rerolls. Raw genmedia output is in runs/p4-char-concept-cb3/genmedia_log.txt (the frog probe was run directly, before the log existed).
